briefing.summary: Comms failure: nothing heard on the assigned frequency or guard for the last five minutes. You've squawked 7600. As required by AIP ENR 1.6, transmit blind on the last assigned frequency so other traffic and ATC (if receiving) know your status and intentions.

challenge.prompt: Make a 'transmitting blind' call stating your intentions.
challenge.expectedText: Mike X-ray Golf, transmitting blind due to comms failure, squawking seven six zero zero, continuing flight planned route, descending to ten thousand, estimating COFF at four five.

elements.label: Transmitting blind phrase
elements.hint: Open with 'transmitting blind' — tells anyone receiving that you can't hear them.

elements.label: Intentions
elements.hint: State route, level, and an ETA so ATC can sequence other traffic around you.

challenge.explanation: AIP ENR 1.6: on lost comms, squawk 7600, transmit blind on the last assigned frequency (and emergency guard) stating callsign, blind-transmission status, intentions (route + level + ETA). The transmission continues per lost-comms procedures regardless of whether anyone copies.
